title: Relaxed guided tour in a small group
text: Manuel led us through the facility in a small group of 12 people in the early afternoon, calmly providing lots of information about the history and always keeping a good eye out for the large tour groups (we always had space and room). We were able to take beautiful pictures and had a great day. Highly recommended!
